independence_note: Companion/extension analyses from the B-SNIP program; do not count each publication as an independent biological replication. B-SNIP1 and its replication sample provide within-program replication, while later imaging/familial/genetic analyses provide construct validation.
Prospective new-participant clinical-utility protocol; separate future cohort, but no outcome result yet.
Related mechanistic question across separate cohorts/review; review overlaps primary literature and is not independent replication.
Distinct genetic analyses with partially overlapping broader schizophrenia genetic resources possible; interpret as convergent genetic evidence, not four wholly independent disease replications.
Primary response-stratified cohorts plus systematic review; review overlaps the field and clozapine exposure is a major confounder.
Multiple primary/meta-analytic streams; some address deficit syndrome, others negative-symptom dimensions or early-risk populations and therefore should not be collapsed into one ontology claim.
Separate cognitive/subtyping programs; 2026 EF study includes a local validation sample but still needs geographically independent replication.
Large positive SuStaIn study versus field-level critical review; intentionally retained as contradictory evidence.
Population, systematic-review and small prospective biomarker cohorts; BIOERES is not yet externally replicated.
Different etiologic mechanisms (GRIN2A, 22q11.2, autoimmune/other rare variants); evidence supports etiologic exceptions, not one common rare-variant subtype.
Large cross-disorder genomic analysis; independent of B-SNIP phenotype construction and directly relevant to diagnostic-boundary validity.
